0.0: Ah, Kaiser! Long time no see. #b#p3000001##k sent word you were coming.
0.1: Anyways, it's good to see you! Forgive me for being so informal, yeah? Ha!
0.2: When I was at the sanctum, hearing about the search made me happy because I thought the war had moved away from here. But it turns out I wasn't so lucky...
0.3: Still, our hard work paid off. You want to check it out?

yes.0: Now...where did I put that book? Please wait a moment.

no.0: You don't have to if you don't want to, I guess. We DID work really hard, though...

1.0: Ah, here it is. This is the #b#t4033372##k. This book explains the method of extracting life energy. Of course, I don't fully understand how it works. This stuff is hard.
1.1: Please take this to #b#p3000001##k. And with that, I'm done! No more brain-busting research for me. Phew.

yes.0: This is a personal request, but... If you happen to get Angelic Buster's signature on something, can I have it? Doesn't matter what it's on...
